# Let users choose how long unsaved drafts remain recoverable

## What & Why
The recovery window is currently fixed. Giving users a clear preference would support people who need more time to notice and recover an unsaved answer or opportunity draft.

## Done looks like
- A user-facing setting controls the recovery duration with a safe default.
- Both draft notices use the selected duration and show the matching countdown.
- The setting persists locally and invalid values fall back safely.
